entries.title: Psalms 92:1
segments: A Psalm or Song for the sabbath day. [It is] good to give thanks to the LORD, and to sing praises to Your name, O Most High;

entries.title: Psalms 92:2
segments: to show forth Your loving-kindness in the morning, and Your faithfulness every night;

entries.title: Psalms 92:3
segments: on the ten [strings], and on the harp, with sounding music on the lyre.

entries.title: Psalms 92:4
segments: For You, LORD, have made Me glad with Your work; I will triumph in the works of Your hands.

entries.title: Psalms 92:5
segments: O LORD, how great are Your works; Your purposes are very deep.

entries.title: Psalms 92:6
segments: A beastly man does not know; nor does a fool understand this.

entries.title: Psalms 92:7
segments: When the wicked spring as the grass, and when all the workers of iniquity blossom, [it is] that they shall be destroyed forever;

entries.title: Psalms 92:8
segments: but You, LORD, are high forever.

entries.title: Psalms 92:9
segments: For, lo, Your enemies, O LORD; for lo, Your enemies shall perish; all the workers of iniquity shall be scattered.

entries.title: Psalms 92:10
segments: But You shall lift up my horn as the wild ox; and I shall be anointed with fresh oil.

entries.title: Psalms 92:11
segments: Also my eye shall see [my desire] on my enemies, and my ears shall hear the wicked who rise up against me.

entries.title: Psalms 92:12
segments: The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree; he shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon.

entries.title: Psalms 92:13
segments: Those that are planted in the house of the LORD shall flourish in the courts of our God.

entries.title: Psalms 92:14
segments: They shall still bring forth fruit in old age; they shall be fat and flowering;

entries.title: Psalms 92:15
segments: to show that the LORD [is] upright; [He is] my rock, and no unrighteousness [is] in Him.
